userConfirmation.scope: Build a metric statistic for reviewing all Medium stories using a read-only signed-in Medium stats capture.

result.verification: Signed-in Medium Stats showed September totals of 3 presentations, 8 views and 0 reads; Audience showed 3 lifetime followers and 2 email subscribers. The lifetime table contained all 11 published stories with 75 presentations, 53 views and 17 reads in aggregate.
